example_metadata.name: Wallet - Connected Phantom state
example_metadata.purpose: Canonical wallet fixture showing a supported Phantom wallet connected in read-only portfolio-view mode.
notes: This is synthetic fixture data, not a real wallet address.
Wallet connection is read-only for portfolio viewing.
Wallet connected state must remain separate from portfolio data loading.
WealthSmith must not imply custody, execution, or fund movement.

scenario.description: User has connected Phantom successfully. Wallet pill is visible in Global Nav. Portfolio data may load separately.
expected_behavior: Do not show Demo Mode banner.
Do not show Connect Wallet CTA as primary nav action.
Show Ask Smith AI when onboarding is not active.
Wallet connection does not imply funds moved.
Wallet connection does not imply portfolio data is fully loaded.

hard_rules: Do not ask for seed phrase or private key.
Do not imply WealthSmith controls the wallet.
Do not imply wallet connection authorizes transactions.
Do not imply wallet connection moves funds.
Do not treat this synthetic address as real user data.

copy.read_only_explanation: Read-only means WealthSmith can use public wallet and supported protocol data to show your portfolio and suggestions. It does not give WealthSmith permission to move funds.
copy.non_custodial_explanation: WealthSmith is non-custodial. Your funds stay in your wallet, and WealthSmith does not hold your crypto or private keys.
copy.security_warning: Never share your seed phrase or private key.

can_explain: why portfolio data may still be loading
smith_ai_context.example_user_question: What does connecting Phantom let WealthSmith do?
smith_ai_context.approved_response: Connecting Phantom lets WealthSmith read supported wallet balances and positions so it can personalize your dashboard and suggestions. Your funds stay in your wallet, and WealthSmith does not get permission to move funds from a read-only connection.
must_include: read supported wallet balances and positions
does not get permission to move funds
